text_blocks.snippet: A non-DOT (Department of Transportation) chain of custody form is a document that tracks the handling and transfer of a drug or alcohol test specimen from the moment it's collected to its final analysis, when it's not subject to DOT regulations. It ensures the integrity of the specimen and verifies that it has been properly handled throughout the testing process.
Key points about non-DOT chain of custody forms:

list.title: Purpose:
list.snippet: The form provides a record of custody, documenting who has possessed the specimen at each stage of the testing process. This is crucial for maintaining the evidence's integrity and demonstrating that it hasn't been tampered with.
